# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Over twenty-two years old by the end of Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a plain, plump girl with a rosy-cheeked, placid appearance and fat hands. When she married, she wore a lavish attire of white satin, tulle, lace, and many diamonds.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c41 P8](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0008), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_

## Personality

Jane is a neat, sensible, and matter-of-fact person who lacks a strong imagination. She is conscientious, industrious, and possesses an even, lady-like temperament. While practical and somewhat unromantic, she is a loyal friend, though she can occasionally display a touch of pride.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c26 P18](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0018), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Goals

- To earn her salary fairly and keep a well-managed school  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- To dedicate herself to teaching without marrying  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea as a classmate and close friend of Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. After studying at Queen's Academy, she earned her teacher's license and later attended the domestic science course at Redmond College. She taught school first at Newbridge and later in Western Canada. While living in the West, she became engaged to Edward Inglis, a wealthy Winnipeg businessman, and subsequently married him in a lavish ceremony at her family home in Avonlea before moving to Winnipeg and traveling to Europe.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_
